root_causes.description: The checkout pod's container was killed and restarted during the incident window (Killing/Started/Created events), and the pod sandbox repeatedly failed to pull the pause image, entering ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff/BackOff. This crash/restart loop of the checkout workload is the dominant fault signal.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted (count=1)

evidence.observed_value: 4 BackOff events plus ErrImagePull (count=3) and ImagePullBackOff (count=4) for the pod sandbox container
evidence.expected_baseline: 0 image pull failures for pod sandbox

evidence.query_or_id: Failed: Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = failed to pull a (count=2)
evidence.observed_value: 2 image pull deadline-exceeded failures for pause sandbox image

evidence.expected_baseline: 0 restarts; restart counter sampled at 0 but kill/restart events confirm crash activity
error_rate < 0.01; absence of request errors is consistent with a restart-based crash rather than propagated request failures

root_causes.description: checkout fans out to cart, payment, email, shipping, currency and product-catalog; a downstream outage could stall or crash checkout, but no downstream error signal propagated into checkout during the window, making this less likely than a direct pod crash.

evidence.expected_baseline: dependency failure would raise checkout error_rate above baseline
error traces present if downstream dependency drove failures

root_causes.description: Resource pressure (e.g. OOM) could force a container restart, but no OOMKilled events or elevated CPU/memory utilization were observed for checkout, so resource stress is a low-probability explanation.

evidence.expected_baseline: cpu/resource stress would show sustained elevated usage
OOM/memory errors would appear in checkout error logs

remediation_steps: Describe the checkout pod to confirm the restart reason and whether the container is crash-looping (kubectl -n otel-demo describe pod -l app=checkout).
Restart/rollout the checkout deployment to clear the crash state and reschedule the pod.
Ensure the pod sandbox image (gcr.io/google-containers/pause) is pre-pulled/accessible on nodes to eliminate ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff back-off.
Review checkout container resource limits and liveness/readiness probes for misconfiguration causing container restarts.
Monitor kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total and pod Killing/Started events for checkout to verify recovery.
